name: AfriMed-QA
intro: AfriMed-QA 是通过社区参与构建的泛非英文多专科医学问答基准，含 15,275 道专家/众包选择题、简答题与消费者问题，来自 16 个国家、60 多所医学院和 32 个专科，并结合自动指标与双盲临床/消费者评价。
org: Intron Health, Georgia Institute of Technology, Google Research, and collaborators
build_method: 泛非社区参与式收集, 临床质量审核, 专家/学员/消费者三路线
metric: 选择题准确率, BERTScore, QuestEval, ROUGE-Lsum, 五点人工评分
eval_feature: 非洲本地临床语境, 国家/专科拆分, 自动与双盲人工评测
build_method_en: Pan-African community-participatory collection, clinical quality review, expert/trainee/consumer tracks
eval_feature_en: Localized African clinical context, country/specialty breakdowns, automated and double-blind human evaluation
intro_en: AfriMed-QA is a community-participatory Pan-African English multi-specialty medical QA benchmark with 15,275 expert and crowdsourced MCQs, short-answer questions, and consumer queries from 16 countries, more than 60 medical schools, and 32 specialties, evaluated with automated metrics and blinded clinician/consumer ratings.

drawio_review_note: REDRAW review aligned with arXiv:2411.15640v4 §§3.1–4.3, Table 2, and Appendix A. The corrected workflow places recruitment and credential checks before contributor-sample review, the at-least-80% approval gate, and authorized contribution. It then joins expert, trainee/clinician, and consumer-query tracks at item-level clinical QA. For human evaluation it randomly samples 3,000 questions first and only then collects LLM responses, rather than sampling responses. Exact 15,275-item counts, 30 models, 379 raters, and 37,435 ratings are preserved.
